_comments.how_to_use: Blank template for one room tested in field test mode (docs/BUILD_BRIEF.md section 8a). Fill every null, delete rooms or walls you do not need, and keep the ids consistent with sources.fieldtest.template.json. Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the model.
_comments.id: Any short name for the home, e.g. 'alejandro-flat'.
_comments.lat_lon: Latitude and longitude of the tested wall in decimal degrees (a phone map pin is fine). Only used if outdoor sources are also given.
_comments.year_built: Year the building was finished, if known. Leave null to use the era below.
_comments.era: One of before_1960, 1960_1979, 1980_1999, 2000_on. Sets the default wall and window ratings and the leak fraction when wall_type or window_type are null.
_comments.unit_floor: Floor the room is on, 1 = ground floor.
_comments.storeys: Number of storeys in the building.
_comments.rooms.area_m2: Floor area: length x width with a tape measure or laser, in m2.
_comments.rooms.volume_m3: Leave null to use area x height.
_comments.exterior_walls.azimuth_deg: Compass direction the outside face of the wall points, 0 = north, 90 = east (phone compass held flat against the wall, facing out).
_comments.exterior_walls.area_m2: Inside width x room height of the wall, in m2, including the window.
_comments.exterior_walls.window_area_m2: Outer frame width x height of all windows in this wall, in m2. Measure, do not leave null: null means the 15 percent default and a wider range.
_comments.exterior_walls.window_type: One of single_pane, double_pane_1980_1999, double_pane_2000_on, double_pane_fixed, with_storm, laminated_acoustic; null = era default.
_comments.exterior_walls.window_fixed: true if the glass cannot be opened (sealed unit), else false.
_comments.exterior_walls.wall_type: One of vinyl_siding_2x4, vinyl_siding_2x6, aluminum_siding_2x6, eifs_stucco_2x6, cement_stucco_2x6, brick_veneer, fiber_cement_upper_floor, concrete_block; null = era default.
_comments.exterior_walls.door_area_m2: Width x height of any door to the outside in this wall, in m2; 0 if none.
_comments.exterior_walls.door_type: One of hollow_core, solid_core, sliding_glass, solid_core_storm; null = hollow_core.
_comments.partitions: One entry per wall shared with another room you also measure. area_m2 = width x height of the shared wall; door = none, closed or open (as it was during the test); door_area_m2 = door width x height, null = 1.6 m2.
_comments.source: Write how and when each value was measured.
